name: JSON Diff
summary: Compare two JSON documents structurally — see added, removed, and changed paths, plus a text unified view.
description: Paste original and modified JSON to get path-level differences (key order ignored). Switch to a sorted-key text unified diff when you want a classic patch view. Parsing and diffing stay in your browser.

faqs.question: Does key order matter?
faqs.answer: No for the structural view. Objects with the same keys and values are treated as equal even if property order differs.

faqs.question: How are arrays compared?
faqs.answer: By index. Reordered items show as changes at those indexes rather than as a move.

faqs.question: Is my JSON uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Diffing runs entirely in your browser.
